architecture.objective: Extract architecture-level organization, subsystem boundaries, interfaces, and structural decisions.
architecture.evidence_to_extract: Subsystem names, file groupings, dependency boundaries, control-flow structure, and architectural tradeoffs.
architecture.ignore: Incidental chatter, raw transcripts, redundant restatements, and unresolved implementation detail unless it changes architecture.
architecture.uncertainty_handling: Prefer explicit uncertainty over inference; mark architecture claims unsupported when the source does not show them.
architecture.contradiction_handling: Preserve conflicting evidence and identify the competing interpretations without collapsing them.
architecture.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority

comprehensive.objective: Preserve the broad legacy Context Distiller behavior while remaining review-only.
comprehensive.evidence_to_extract: Durable facts, decisions, open questions, bugs, rules, preferences, files, and next actions.
comprehensive.ignore: Nothing material, but do not reproduce raw transcripts unless needed as evidence.
comprehensive.uncertainty_handling: Summarize only what the source and selected evidence support.
comprehensive.contradiction_handling: Report contradictions explicitly and keep unsupported claims separate.
comprehensive.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority

decisions.objective: Extract decisions, commitments, constraints, and durable policy statements.
decisions.evidence_to_extract: Decision language, acceptance criteria, policy choices, and explicit commitments.
decisions.ignore: Narrative detail that does not affect decisions or obligations.
decisions.uncertainty_handling: Separate confirmed decisions from tentative ideas and missing context.
decisions.contradiction_handling: Surface conflicting decision statements side by side.
decisions.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority

failures-and-corrections.objective: Extract failures, repairs, retries, corrections, and the evidence that supports them.
failures-and-corrections.evidence_to_extract: Error symptoms, validator failures, retry attempts, fixes, and correction rationale.
failures-and-corrections.ignore: Successful repetition that adds no new failure or correction evidence.
failures-and-corrections.uncertainty_handling: Keep failure evidence separate from guesses about root cause.
failures-and-corrections.contradiction_handling: Retain contradictory diagnostics and identify the unresolved gap.
failures-and-corrections.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority

roadmap-and-open-work.objective: Extract roadmap items, follow-up tasks, and open work that should remain reviewable.
roadmap-and-open-work.evidence_to_extract: Roadmap statements, queued tasks, deferred items, and explicitly open questions.
roadmap-and-open-work.ignore: Completed work unless needed to contextualize remaining work.
roadmap-and-open-work.uncertainty_handling: Mark roadmap claims as provisional unless directly supported by source evidence.
roadmap-and-open-work.contradiction_handling: Record contradictions instead of normalizing them into a single next step.
roadmap-and-open-work.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority

authority-and-workflow-rules.objective: Extract authority boundaries, workflow constraints, and review gates.
authority-and-workflow-rules.evidence_to_extract: Authority limits, review-only rules, stop conditions, and state transition constraints.
authority-and-workflow-rules.ignore: Operational filler that does not change authority or workflow.
authority-and-workflow-rules.uncertainty_handling: Prefer conservative interpretations of authority when the source is ambiguous.
authority-and-workflow-rules.contradiction_handling: Retain the competing rule statements and note which one is stronger evidence.
authority-and-workflow-rules.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority

synthesis.objective: Combine validated pass artifacts into a review-only synthesis artifact.
synthesis.evidence_to_extract: Validated pass outputs, their hashes, their dependencies, and the cross-pass conclusions they support.
synthesis.ignore: Raw source rereads unless required to cite provenance already validated in a prior pass.
synthesis.uncertainty_handling: Summarize only what the validated pass artifacts support.
synthesis.contradiction_handling: Keep pass disagreements visible rather than resolving them silently.
synthesis.maximum_authority: review-only; no canonical context changes; no patch acceptance; no execution authority
